provenance.provenance_note: The uploaded reviewed file originally declared CLAUDE-OPUS-5 for all 60 rows. The row-level reviewer_id column was removed by explicit project-owner request; provenance is retained here so the labels are not misrepresented as independent human validation.
provenance.permitted_use: diagnostic challenge review and failure-mode analysis
provenance.not_permitted_as: independent human validation or externally validated accuracy evidence
provenance.sampling_frame_note: Frozen and no longer reproducible. Two of its three strata (HIGH_SIMILARITY_STRUCTURAL_NEGATIVE, BUYER_DECLARED_RESOLVED) were drawn from the France-level benchmark, and the sampler that drew them was removed with it on 2026-08-15. The PRIMARY_ACCEPTED stratum was drawn from production accepted links and is independent of that benchmark. The completed labels are retained rather than discarded because that stratum carries the accepted-link precision diagnostic.
provenance.active_evidence_scope: Only the PRIMARY_ACCEPTED stratum is quoted as active evidence. The challenge strata remain a failure-mode diagnostic tied to the retired sampling frame.

structural_negative_challenge.use: failure-mode diagnostic only; not ground truth or a national FPR denominator

buyer_declared_challenge.use: positive-case recruitment diagnostic only; not a recall denominator

decision: Keep M_B @ 0.70 frozen and provisional. The diagnostic accepted-link precision does not meet the 0.80 point target. Because these are not independent human labels, obtain human specialist review before recalibration or external accuracy claims.
